WITH DailyVisits AS (
  SELECT
    PARSE_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m%d', date) AS visit_timestamp,
    SUM(totals.visits) AS total_visits
  FROM
    `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  GROUP BY
    visit_timestamp
)
SELECT
  *
FROM
  ML.SEASONALITY(
    TABLE DailyVisits,
    data_col => 'total_visits',
    timestamp_col => 'visit_timestamp'
  )
ORDER BY
  visit_timestamp
